# Material Symbols Rounded

[日本語](README.ja.md)

The variable font of Material Symbols Rounded by Google, from the `variablefont/` directory of [google/material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) at commit `10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7`, under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, the repository's license file). `lamina_add_resources` cuts the icon fonts of each program from it at build time ([docs/resources.md](../../docs/resources.md)).

| File | Upstream name | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `MaterialSymbolsRounded.woff2` | `MaterialSymbolsRounded[FILL,GRAD,opsz,wght].woff2` | 5 402 952 bytes |
| `MaterialSymbolsRounded.codepoints` | `MaterialSymbolsRounded[FILL,GRAD,opsz,wght].codepoints` | 79 421 bytes |

The files are unchanged; only the names are shortened, since brackets and commas are awkward in CMake paths. The WOFF2 holds the same font as the 15 235 612-byte TTF of the same commit at about a third of the size: a subset cut from it is byte for byte the subset cut from the TTF.
